lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 5-6 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters. The spacing between centroids is relatively uniform in the mid-flank but expands slightly as the body tapers toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a defined grid of high-luminance anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible along the mid and upper flank, exhibiting a pronounced light-to-shadow vertical gradient defining the longitudinal ridges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A high density of smaller, high-luminance blobs is distributed across the entire silhouette of the first dorsal fin, showing less grid-alignment than the flank spots.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin shows a dense, non-linear distribution of small spots, and the caudal fin displays trailing edge spotting patterns.
